entries.title: Scherzo (from The Firebird, arr. Stravinsky & Dushkin)
entries.notes: Light, fast passagework, harmonics and pizzicato; rhythmic precision
entries.level_basis: Existing Berceuse and Scherzo L7; Danse russe L6

entries.title: Tango (arr. Dushkin)

entries.title: Variation d'Apollon (from Apollon musagète)
